findings.classification: Reported Xbox v1.13X GameMaker/GML reconstruction; not official released-source port
findings.codeGate: Custom noncommercial licence prohibits compiled distribution and requires ownership of original game. Reported conditional permission to publish asset-free source is not an observed permissive whole-game browser redistribution grant.
findings.dependencyGate: Exact UndertaleModTool 0.8.2.0 tag has GPLv3 licence text; external importer tool, not assumed linked game runtime. GameMaker compiler/export runner terms and exact runtime dependencies unclosed.
findings.contentGate: Imports original data.win; external asset directories are not a complete independent content pack. Full graphics/animation/audio/fonts/maps/dialogue and provenance absent.
findings.browserGate: Real HTML5/WebGL options observed; no successful export, WASM evidence, silent startup, gameplay, save or cleanup verification.
findings.decision: Ineligible under current requirements; obtain applicable permissive modified-compiled-distribution rights before browser integration work.

findings.classification: Matching-target GameCube reconstruction; reported complete code/linking for three regions, not reproduced here
findings.codeGate: CC0 only for owned original contributions. Root rights notice excludes third-party game-derived expression and grants no blanket retail-equivalent output permission.
findings.dependencyGate: Historical ODE BSD separate from game-specific changes and nested OPCODE uncertainty. eCos GPLv2+ with linking exception and Sun headers read separately. Exact MusyX MIT notice does not prove inherited middleware rights. Exact Dolphin SDK reconstruction tree has no identified overall licence.
findings.contentGate: Original input remains required, no complete independently authored model/world/text/audio content.
findings.browserGate: Original console matching target, not a verified browser port.
findings.decision: Ineligible; same game identity as native port, not two additions.

findings.classification: Decompilation-derived native Super Mario Strikers port with Android dependency adaptations; not browser-tested
findings.codeGate: CC0 contributor code does not grant original game rights; source-only policy explicitly does not certify all reconstructed source.
findings.dependencyGate: Vendored Aurora MIT; MusyX MIT and ODE BSD notices separately read, inherited modifications unclosed. FFmpeg default can select system/vendor binaries; dedicated THP-only build disables autodetection and does not request GPL/nonfree flags, no actual binary terms certified. Full selected dependency inventory absent.
findings.contentGate: Requires original data. CMake identifies game memory-card-derived Windows icon and resource script selects tracked strikers.ico; media payloads not acquired. README asset-free description is not full provenance.
findings.browserGate: Native Dawn WebGPU/SDL3 does not prove Emscripten/browser delivery. Selected audio transport opens and resumes default playback; browser silent-start/save/scheduler/stop implementation unverified.
findings.decision: Ineligible; establish inherited code/runtime rights and full authored assets before audited browser build and silent gameplay acceptance.

catalogDeduplication: Neither title occurs in existing catalog; upstream/port and regional editions treated as one Strikers game identity. Main/vanilla Undertale branches treated as one title.
